critical_code_review_comments: server.py upload: file.read() happens before the 8MB size check, so the server still allocates memory for an over-sized payload before rejecting (DoS risk). Stream and check size while reading, or use UploadFile.spool_max_size + Content-Length pre-check.

server.py: /api/files/{path} is unauthenticated by design (public). OK for portfolio images but be aware any uploaded file URL is publicly discoverable if path is leaked. Consider signed URLs for non-public uploads in future.
server.py: requests (sync) used inside async storage_put/storage_get. Already wrapped in asyncio.to_thread for upload/serve which is fine, but consider migrating to httpx.AsyncClient for cleanliness.
server.py: storage_put/_get refresh storage_key on 403 but does not handle 401; minor robustness issue.
Admin.jsx duplicates upload logic for cover and gallery; extract a useUpload hook to dedupe.
server.py now 670+ lines; growing - consider splitting routes (auth, projects, inquiries, files, client) into modules.
